lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1643: the dice riders pay

Slice 4, unit 1 of 3 (task #98). Re-measured the effect tail on the
current catalog: 303 strings, 164 parsed, 139 read by nothing. Thirty of
the unread ones carry a `+N` or `+NdN` DAMAGE promise — the simplest
sentence in the whole column, and the one no code could see. A Legendary
Energy Hammer said "+1d6 shock damage" and swung for its printed 2d10 and
nothing more, every time, for the life of the game.

Two families land, both on machinery that already existed:

  • flatRider — bonus damage owed on EVERY hit, no condition attached (9
    weapons). It goes through the same rollEffectBonusDamage as the
    conditioned bonus rather than beside it: two sentences on the card,
    one arithmetic on the swing, and two call sites is how they end up
    disagreeing about whether a resist applies.
  • riderDot — a rider the card gives a SPAN (3 weapons), seeded into the
    Combat-Parity `typed_dot` the damage-type proc has used since it
    shipped. Keyed by the WEAPON, not by the type, so a guaranteed promise
    never swaps places with the 45% type flare sitting on the same body.

The rule that splits them is the card's own words: a stated duration
festers, no duration lands now. Guessing from the damage type instead
would have turned four cards into two different lies.

Four new conditions, each backed by real rows in enemies.json — a
condition that matches nothing is the defect, not the fix, which is what
`structure` has been since the day it was added: armored (47/135),
unarmored (88/135), natural_armor (26 — armour the creature GREW; a
machine and a man in plate both have armour and neither has a hide),
burnable (39, the vulnerable:burn roster). The conditioned-bonus regex
gained a second, stricter FLAT pass requiring the literal word "damage",
so "+1 damage to tech" is finally read while the shields' "+2 AC vs energy
damage" can never be read as bonus damage.

Three cards reworded, because nothing in the game can satisfy them: Mud
Heater Sword (measured — zero enemies resist or fear cold, so "+1d6
against cold creatures" could never once fire; now fire-vulnerable, which
39 can), Mud Sling (glass is not an enemy; now unarmoured), Giant Bone
Knuckles ("arm's-reach targets" is always true for a barehanded weapon —
a condition written as though it were sometimes false).

⚠ The plus sign is the whole test, and the first draft without it was
worth recording: it claimed 73 weapons instead of 19. Every rune-caster
restates its own base dice in the effect column, so all 45 would have
doubled — a Legendary scepter going 2d20 → 4d20 on a change meant for
three mud blades — and the shields count dice they TAKE AWAY, which is
the sign error that flatters a weapon most. Widening the verb list was
the bug here, which is the opposite of what slices 1c and 2 taught.

The card now says both riders as rules, since until this OTA neither paid
and a line is the only way to tell the two versions apart.

ota1643 (36 tests) pins the wins, every boundary the reader must not
cross, that each new condition is reachable by a real enemy, and an audit
over the whole catalog naming the four rows still owed to units 4b (the
eight shield +AC promises) and 4c (the exotic reword pass) — named, so a
NEWLY authored dead promise fails instead of shipping.

Gates: all 18 green by exit code. Full suite green.
